name: Reason
overview: Scripture reveals that true reason is rooted in the fear of the LORD, which is the beginning of knowledge and wisdom, as Proverbs highlights. Human reasoning apart from God can be deceptive, leading to paths that seem right but end in death. Yet, God invites us to reason with Him, offering forgiveness and transformation through Christ, whose sacrificial love secures eternal life. Practical wisdom, such as counting the cost before building, underscores the importance of thoughtful, God-centered decision-making.
